page: Microsoft Azure D32ps_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the ARM64 architecture. It features 32 dedicated physical cores using the Microsoft Neoverse-N2 processor running at 3.4 GHz, with a single thread per core and no hyperthreading. The instance is equipped with 128.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per core. It has 128 MB of L3 cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 64 KB of L1d cache. There is no bundled local storage or integrated GPU, but the instance is Premium Storage capable.

In benchmark evaluations, the D32ps_v6 demonstrates strong multi-core capabilities and exceptional memory performance. Multi-core stress-ng and Geekbench tests rank in the top 25 percent, supported by the 32 dedicated physical cores. Memory bandwidth for large uncached blocks is top-tier, reaching 450.97 GB/sec for read operations and 188.48 GB/sec for write operations. Database operations and memory scores on Passmark also achieve top-tier ratings, while Redis SET operations and static web serving throughput register strong performance. However, single-core performance and large-model LLM inference prompt processing remain average to poor.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ARM-based Neoverse-N2 architecture offers high resource density and power efficiency compared to traditional x86 hardware classes, translating to favorable performance-per-resource ratios for multi-threaded workloads. This instance is highly suited for scale-out applications, database operations, multi-threaded decompression, static web serving, and general-purpose enterprise workloads that benefit from dedicated physical cores and high memory bandwidth without requiring local SSD storage.
